light.app-backdrop: radial-gradient(at 15% 10%, rgba(64, 200, 224, 0.5) 0, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 85% 85%, rgba(90, 140, 255, 0.45) 0, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f6fa 0%, #eef2fb 100%)

dark.app-backdrop: radial-gradient(at 15% 10%, rgba(0, 150, 180, 0.4) 0, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 85% 85%, rgba(60, 90, 220, 0.35) 0, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(160deg, #071318 0%, #0c1224 100%)
